title: 第1193章 不对劲这女人很不对劲第1192章 这女人有些不一样了
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
不远处。
火堆依然有火苗在摇曳着。
林云看着对面的叶倾仙。
此刻，喝了几坛酒之后，她脸蛋也是有些绯红。
整个人美不胜收。
吃饱喝足了，某些想法自然也是变得蠢蠢欲动。
叶倾仙似笑非笑的看了一眼对面的坏家伙。
他的眼神有些赤裸裸的。
是那么的炙热滚烫。
如果是之前，她肯定会冷冰冰的说一句滚开。
但是现在，她也有些想要放纵一把。
叶倾仙抱着酒坛子：“喝呀，继续。”
她仰头，就这样咕噜噜的灌了起来。
酒液从嘴角溢出，顺着她修长的脖颈往下滑落。
很快就打湿了她的衣襟和胸口。
这一幕看起来无比的妖冶，有着一股别样的勾人的魅力。
林云也是喉结微微滚动。
看着冰清玉洁的仙子此刻却是在买醉一般。
林云的心也是微微警惕了起来。
这不对劲啊。

她肯定是碰到了什么事情。
所以这才一醉方休。
但是身为堂堂叶家天女，还是仙皇修为的大佬。
她能有什么烦恼呢？
林云很快就想到了炎焚绝那厮。
他的心也是微微一沉。
那个家伙其实算是他主动引过来的，对方肯定是想要对付他。
两人之间有着不可解的矛盾。
虽然没有直接的仇怨，但是身份立场就决定了双方不可能和解。
尤其是这家伙之前还想对南宫潇潇下手。
这几乎就触碰到了林老魔的逆鳞。
对于接下来的处境，他是有些预料的，而且也并没有多担心。
而现在，看着娇柔如破碎白月光的叶倾仙，林云也是有些心疼。
本来他看着美艳无双的仙子姐姐还有些蠢蠢欲动。
但是现在，却只剩下了心疼和不解。
林云站起来，一把抢过她手中的酒坛。
“好了，别喝了。”林云柔声说道。
他目光温柔怜惜的看着眼前这个在自己面前展现着自己脆弱一面的仙子。
“给我，我还要~”叶倾仙的双目有些迷离，声音也有些甜腻。
她伸出白嫩的手臂要夺回酒坛。

林云却是直接自己咕噜噜的喝了起来。
很快，一坛顶级仙酿就下肚了。
“我也要。”叶倾仙打开一坛酒，又是抱着酒坛子喝了起来。
“好，你要喝是吧，我陪你。”
content_en:
Not far away.
There was still a flame swaying in the fire.
Lin Yun looked at Ye Qingxian opposite.
At this moment, after drinking a few jars of wine, her face was also a little blushing.
The whole person is beyond beautiful.
After eating and drinking enough, some thoughts naturally become ready to come to mind.
Ye Qingxian glanced at the bad guy opposite with a half-smile.
There was something naked in his eyes.
It's so hot.
If it had been before, she would have said coldly, "Go away."
But now, she also wants to indulge.
Ye Qingxian held the wine jar: "Drink, continue."
She raised her head and started drinking.
The wine spilled from the corner of her mouth and slid down her slender neck.
It soon wetted her clothes and chest.
This scene looks extremely coquettish and has a different kind of seductive charm.
Lin Yun's Adam's apple rolled slightly.
The fairy who looked at the pure and pure girl seemed to be drunk at the moment.
Lin Yun also became slightly wary.
This isn't right.
Something must have happened to her.
That's why I got drunk and rested.
But as a dignified goddess of the Ye family, she is also a leader in the cultivation of the Immortal Emperor.
What trouble could she have?
Lin Yun quickly thought of Yan Fenjue.
His heart also sank slightly.
In fact, he took the initiative to lure that guy here, and the other party definitely wanted to deal with him.
There is an insoluble contradiction between the two.
Although there is no direct enmity, the status and position of the two parties determine that reconciliation between the two parties is impossible.
Especially since this guy wanted to attack Nangong Xiaoxiao before.
This almost touched Old Demon Lin's reverse scale.
He was somewhat expecting the next situation, and he wasn't too worried.
But now, looking at Ye Qingxian, who was as delicate as the broken white moonlight, Lin Yun also felt a little distressed.
Originally, he was a little anxious when he looked at the incomparably beautiful fairy sister.
But now, all that's left is heartache and confusion.
Lin Yun stood up and snatched the wine jar from her hand.
"Okay, stop drinking." Lin Yun said softly.
He looked at the fairy in front of him with tenderness and pity, showing his fragile side in front of him.
"Give it to me, I want it~" Ye Qingxian's eyes were a little blurry, and her voice was a little sweet.
She stretched out her white and tender arms to take back the wine jar.
Lin Yun just started drinking it.
Soon, a jar of top-quality fairy wine was consumed.
"I want it too." Ye Qingxian opened a jar of wine and drank from the jar again.
"Okay, you want to drink, right? I'll accompany you."
